description: Whether a constituent is an opaque part depends on where it stands in the chosen derivation, not on what it derives. The two `inner` constituents derive the same empty span. The first lies inside the opaque part `outer`, so it is no opaque part, and its token has no parts and sounds ``. The second is an opaque part itself, so its token sounds `?` (engine §5, §11).
grammar:
%rule text (outer inner)
%rule outer :- $.verbatim-text | inner

%rule inner :- $.verbatim-text | ε %emits $ :: X
